headline: Google discloses opt-in Workspace data use for AI personalization and training
summary: In an October 16, 2026 update to an older AI safeguards post, Google says users can choose to connect Workspace apps to other Google services, and that data processed through these features may personalize other Google experiences and, depending on settings, be used to train generative-AI models or reviewed by people in limited circumstances. Google's Help Center describes Search AI Mode and Ask Maps using summaries, excerpts and inferences from connected content. These are first-party disclosures about a user-enabled feature; the documentation does not establish adoption or independently audited implementation.
